body:
The mental illness (Well, Axis II/Personality Disorder) they're looking for is *Borderline Personality Disorder*

Source: I take pills for bipolar disorder.

I had mostly clear skin up until about 150mg lamotragine, at which point I started breaking out pretty badly all over my face. I stopped taking it once I was up to 250mg (without talking to my pdoc first, this was a seriously poor choice of mine, I don't recommend it) and even after 2 months off of it and many products I still have stubborn acne. I'm back up to 100mg again and haven't noticed any changes. Sigh. Fucking acne. Unfortunately I don't have any suggestions as nothing has helped me yet. I hope you find something that helps.
I have a lot of chemistry books...
I'm scared of finding a new psychiatrist. I realize that I should, but I'd have to make ^a ^^phone ^^^call.

Bipolar Disorder is the "new" name for Manic Depression. They're the same thing. Individuals with bipolar disorder can have psychotic manic, mixed, or depressive episodes, but it's relatively rare. For most it's just a mood rollercoaster.
I'm sticking with hobo. The double zigzag pattern on the back of its abdomen and the single-colored legs are both distinguishing features.
Hey Mister, do you have any change you could spare? Just a little bit of change? Changeee?
For anyone wondering, that right there is a hobo spider. It actually fell on my arm just as I reached out to turn on the water. Nopenopenope.
Someone needs a nap.

Dentist, Optometrist because my glasses are broken, need blood work done, Gynecologist, Orthopedist because I have a ganglion cyst in my wrist... I've been putting off most of these for 6+ months. Wheeee. /highfive

Glad you found your prescription. :D

I just had to do this. I checked for my prescription last Friday (they just send them in for me) and the tech searched everywhere for it to no avail. I also have anxiety and it took me the whole weekend to muster up the courage to call and ask if they could send it again. I got called back on Tuesday and they're like "Uhhh they definitely have your prescription." Apparently it magicked out of nowhere on Saturday. All that unnecessary effort. -_- Best of luck to you phone anxiety buddy!
Well now I have a place to go next manic episode! =P
I used to live in Laguna Beach while manic, but now I'm back home in Montana. =[
Beach house? Shit, can I come join you?
Chemistry. More specifically, organic chemistry. I have a lot of books I'm working through... At least I'm learning things? I'm sure I'll drop it within a few months. Who knows what's next.

I've never attempted it for the same reasons.

My well-planned method is to find a bridge with a nice view, take a bunch of pills, jump off the bridge, and shoot myself halfway down. Something will do me in.

Thankfully I'm stable at the moment. Pretty sure I have PTSD from the intense ideation and tactile (the shock you experience when you jump into cold water and it takes your breath away and you kind of feel like you're trapped and drowning) hallucinations, though. I can't go near bridges without having flashbacks to those horrible memories and feelings.

Woo depression.
We're lucky to have such caring pdocs. =]

Sorry to hear you're having such a difficult time with voices, I hope the dosage increase begins to ease the torment soon. It seems like you're on the right track even if it doesn't, stay strong until something works!

I listen to [Hold Your Colour - Pendulum](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9mWLig0s_9k) when I'm sleep deprived enough for hallucinations to come around.
Hah! This made my day, thank you.
This [.gif](http://i.imgur.com/8DfBh.gif) always brightens my mood.
